text: 1. Not of Chinese nationality but holding a valid foreign passport.And there is a record of having actually resided abroad for more than two years within the last four years (up to April 30 of the admission year).2. Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit to China.3. Aged 18 to 30, with a high school diploma or above.4. Diligent and eager to learn, with good academic performance, upright conduct, abiding by laws and regulations, no record of violating school rules and regulations, no record of public security penalties, and no criminal record.5. Language proficiency requirements:(1) Those with a basic level of Chinese proficiency must submit proof of their Chinese proficiency, such as training certificates or HSK level certificates. If the Chinese proficiency is zero, they must participate in the Chinese proficiency training organized by the school before enrollment. (2) Applicants whose native language is not English must provide proof of IELTS Academic (no less than 6.0, with no less than 5.5 in each section), TOEFL (no less than 80 in IBT, with no less than 15 in each section), or other equivalent English test scores. Applicants whose native language is English or whose highest academic degree was taught entirely in English may be exempted from the English test score certificate, but they must submit a certificate of English teaching issued by their graduating school.
